images.title: The number machine
images.purpose: Show a Y shaped machine with two inputs and one output that follows one hidden rule every time.
images.composition: A Y shaped machine fills the centre: two inputs enter at the top, one output leaves at the bottom; wide white space around it.
exact_structure: One Y shaped machine drawn as two short arms joining a single stem, outlined in #2B2B2B with a light grey #6B7280 fill, and a small round box where the arms join containing "?" in reddish purple #CC79A7.
At the top of the left arm a teal #0072B2 input tile with "5"; at the top of the right arm an amber #E69F00 input tile with "2".
At the bottom of the stem a green #009E73 output tile with "8".
Down arrows in #2B2B2B run into each arm top and out of the stem.
One short caption under the output: "same rule every time".
Exactly 2 inputs and 1 output; no other numbers and no formula.
rejection: more or fewer than 2 inputs or 1 output
images.takeaway: A number machine does the same thing to its two inputs each time, and we can find the rule.
images.description: A Y shaped machine taking in 5 and 2, a hidden rule marked ?, and giving out 8.
images.context: Shown beside the Formula Detective text.
images.teaching_notes: Ask what could be done to 5 and 2 to get 8, then test it on other inputs.

image_decisions.why: The machine picture shows inputs, rule and output, which is what the formula 2a − b must describe.
